catalogue.name: The Smiths of A.R.E.S.
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Combat Protocols
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Hearts of Iron: All friendly units gain Tough(+1) until end of turn. Use max once per turn.

You may activate one of the protocols below per turn, and each only once per game.
● Concentrate Fire: All friendly non-cc attacks gain the Accurate trait until end of turn.
● Close Quarters Battle: All friendly units gain Extra Strike(1) until end of turn.
● Rapid Redeployment: All friendly units gain Move(+2) until end of turn.

sharedRules.name: ARES Robo Master
sharedRules.description: May attach to any Roboto unit.

sharedRules.name: Inaccurate(if no Smith within 6”)
sharedRules.description: If an attack is Inaccurate, -1 to hit. Multiple sources of Inaccurate does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Software Hub(1x Machine Wraith)
sharedRules.description:
When attacking, attach or re-attach up to 1 (in total) software token to any unit within 12". If the attached unit is destroyed, remove the token from play.

Independent: software may also be attached to unit within 12” of current attachment instead of attack.

Machine Wraith Software:
- If attached to a friendly unit, unit gets Loathing
- If attached to enemy unit, unit is Irradiated

sharedRules.name: Software Hub(2x Machine Wraith)
sharedRules.description:
When attacking, attach or re-attach up to 2 (in total) software token to any unit within 12". If the attached unit is destroyed, remove the token from play.

Independent: software may also be attached to unit within 12” of current attachment instead of attack.

Machine Wraith Software:
- If attached to a friendly unit, unit gets Loathing
- If attached to enemy unit, unit is Irradiated

sharedRules.name: Software Hub(5x software, independent, boosted signal)
sharedRules.description:
When attacking, attach or re-attach up to 5 (in total) software token to any unit within 12". If the attached unit is destroyed, remove the token from play.

Independent: software may also be attached to unit within 12” of current attachment instead of attack.

Boosted signal: range is 18”.

Software:
- Targeting suite: attached unit count all its non-CC attacks as Masterwork.
- Threat Assessor: attached unit gets Tough(2) or Tough(+1) if it already has.
- Weapon Gremlin: attached unit counts all its attacks as hazardous.
- Tattletale: attached unit loses Hidden/Camouflage/Concealment and is spotted despite low-visibility conditions.

sharedRules.name: Forgeblessed Armour
sharedRules.description: Wound(+1) hits against this unit counts as wound(+0) (+5p/unit).

sharedRules.name: Mindlink
sharedRules.description: All of the unit’s weapons gain Mindlink (+10p/unit).

sharedRules.name: Static Shroud
sharedRules.description: Unit gains concealment against attacks from beyond 18” (+10p/unit).

sharedRules.name: Redundancy Protocol
sharedRules.description: Unit may receive the benefits of one (1) specified Combat Protocol for free once per game (+5p/unit).
